$doc: docs/DESIGN_Scenario_Regression.md §3 — C7 (CE-2152) the Leader himself goes down: succession, then the same rescue. From the header's Judge (1)-(3): a rifleman (not the Medic) holds UnitSubordinate.Designation SquadLeader within 5 s of the fall; the Medic and only he carries the Leader, covering rounds first, put down alive. Same cues and caveats as ua-casualty-care (the drop is done at contact, the first round at the Hostile). NOT expressed: Rescue winning, the squad's return to the fight, the 2.5 m cover point. TRIAGE (CE-4042): (a) the squad's drill IS readable — the Squad entity's SquadDrillTrace component (Active, Kind, Phase, Care.Stage; Kind 11 = CasualtyCare, 12 = FireAndMovement, 7 = SquadHold), so 'the squad runs CasualtyCare' is a field cue, not a task cue (DESIGN §9 'squad drill' gap is closed for this); (b) IsEmbarkedTag.Mode is not in the entity dump (the translator writes Vehicle + Seat only) — carried / put down is the embark cue (IsEmbarkedTag present / gone). Measured: the drill starts 3.5 s, the Medic goes 4.75 s, the man is carried 14.25 s, put down 24.25 s.
